items.quote: Clients are People, Not Paychecks! As real estate agents, it's essential to remember that our clients are not just numbers or potential commissions; they are real people with real needs and dreams.
items.statement: Clients are not just numbers or potential commissions; they are real people with real needs and dreams.

items.quote: And remember, treating clients like people might just be the secret ingredient to long-term success.
items.statement: Treating clients like people might just be the secret ingredient to long-term success.

items.quote: Building trust and providing value should always come first.
